name: Project Scaffold & Configuration
description: Initialize the Vite + React + TypeScript project with bun create vite. Produces a deterministic set of configuration files (vite.config.ts, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, tsconfig.json, package.json, index.html, src/main.tsx, src/index.css) that define the build toolchain, styling system, routing, real-time backend wiring, and test runner for the exemplar.tools documentation site. This component owns the configuration surface only — no application components or pages. Downstream consumers (app_shell, data_layer, pages) depend on the file manifest, dependency versions, Tailwind tokens, font-family assignments, CSS utilities, and package.json scripts produced here.

data_access.rationale: This component reads and writes project configuration files (vite.config.ts, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, tsconfig.json, package.json, index.html, src/main.tsx, src/index.css) which are PUBLIC source code artifacts. It reads from the npm registry (PUBLIC package metadata) to resolve dependency versions. No PII, secrets, or INTERNAL data is accessed. All outputs are deterministic configuration files committed to version control.

side_effects.rationale: Creates or overwrites project configuration and entry point files that define the build toolchain, styling system, and application bootstrap for the documentation site.
Installs npm packages into node_modules via bun. These are third-party open-source packages fetched from the public npm registry.
Fetches package metadata and tarballs from the public npm registry to install dependencies. No authentication tokens or private registry access required.

authority.rationale: This component is the single source of truth for: (1) project_configuration — all config files (vite.config.ts, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, tsconfig.json, package.json) and their structural contracts; (2) build_toolchain — Vite dev server port, build output directory, vitest configuration, and script commands; (3) css_design_tokens — Tailwind color tokens, font-family tokens, the bg-grid utility, and base layer styles that all downstream components depend on; (4) dependency_versions — the canonical list of npm packages and their version constraints. No other component may modify these files or redefine these tokens without coordinating through this contract.
